template.name: Cascade Attribution Disambiguation & Thompson Correction
template.description: Audits execution traces marked with failure_mode='cascading' to identify false positive cascade attributions. Validates upstream task outputs via replay and cross-trace witness queries. Downgrades spurious cascading failures to independent_failure and produces Thompson posterior correction records to restore penalized upstream task variants.

params.query_template: SELECT id, tasks, failure_mode, created_at FROM activity_execution_traces WHERE failure_mode.type = 'cascading' AND created_at > time::now() - 7d ORDER BY created_at DESC

tasks.name: Extract upstream task outputs and impulse IDs

params.prompt_template: Given a cascading failure trace, extract: (1) upstream_task_id from failure_mode.context, (2) upstream task's output_impulse_ids, (3) upstream task's output shape/signature. Return structured JSON with fields: upstream_task_id, output_impulse_ids, output_signature_hash, task_index.

tasks.name: Cross-reference upstream impulse IDs in other successful traces

params.query_template: SELECT id, tasks, success FROM activity_execution_traces WHERE tasks[*].input_impulse_ids OVERLAP ? AND success = true AND created_at > time::now() - 24h

tasks.name: Validate upstream task output via replay and witness correlation

params.prompt_template: For each cascading failure trace: (1) Check if upstream task's output_impulse_ids appear in ≥1 witness trace input_impulse_ids with success=true. (2) Determine if upstream output is valid (correct shape, non-null, matches baseline signature). (3) Classify as 'valid_upstream' or 'invalid_upstream'. Return JSON with: cascading_trace_id, upstream_task_id, has_witness, witness_count, output_validity, confidence_score, reclassification_recommendation.

tasks.name: Identify false cascade attributions and independent failures

params.prompt_template: Filter audit report: identify traces where output_validity='valid_upstream' AND has_witness=true. These are false cascade attributions (upstream succeeded, downstream failed independently). For each: extract cascading_trace_id, upstream_task_id, downstream_task_id, failure_reason_independent. Return JSON array with fields: cascading_trace_id, upstream_task_id, downstream_task_id, reclassification_from, reclassification_to, confidence, reason.

tasks.name: Compute Thompson posterior corrections for penalized upstream tasks

params.prompt_template: For each false cascade identified: (1) Retrieve upstream task's current Thompson posterior (α, β). (2) Reverse the spurious penalty: cascading victim received αΔ=0, βΔ=0 but parent received β+=γ^1 penalty. (3) Compute correction: subtract the propagated penalty from upstream task's β. (4) Compute corrected posterior and confidence interval. Return JSON with: upstream_task_id, upstream_variant_id, current_alpha, current_beta, penalty_reversal_delta_beta, corrected_alpha, corrected_beta, confidence_interval_lower, confidence_interval_upper, correction_rationale.

tasks.name: Persist Thompson corrections and reclassification metadata

recovery_test.test_query: After corrections persist: verify upstream task variant's Thompson posterior (α, β) matches corrected values within tolerance (±0.01). Planted cascade-attribution scenario should show upstream task's success rate restored on next harness run.
